item.description: Net migration to the UK fell to 77,000 for the year to June, the lowest annual figure since 1997 excluding the Covid years, statistics showed on Thursday. The net migration figures – the difference between the numbers of people arriving in and leaving Britain – are a boost for the UK’s centre-left Labour government, which has been under pressure from the hard right anti-immigration Reform UK party on the issue.
